title: Static Deep Breast Combed Head and Sickle Tail Rooster
description: One new whole stylised static rooster-like farm bird. A deep rounded forward breast and long back rise through a full upright narrowing neck to a small short-beaked head. A thick serrated single comb and two complete rounded hanging wattles frame the head. Two folded side wings, stout upper legs with longer narrow shanks and two real cleft ground feet support the animal. Three complete unequal thick sickle-tail feathers sweep high behind the body then curve down to the rear, not a radial peacock fan or one straight parrot tail. All body stations, limb profiles, comb, wattle and sweeping feather paths newly authored. Not an old bird with a coloured crest pasted on or a deleted peacock fan. One model zero scenes. Coarse fixed farm-bird artwork only, no exact breed, anatomy, feather microstructure, stance biomechanics, crowing, reproduction, care, animal use, safety, rig, animation or interaction claim.
